official_measurement_examples.name: New system commencement
official_measurement_examples.fact: The new local plan system regulations came into force on 25 March 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Mandatory gateways
official_measurement_examples.fact: The new process contains three mandatory gateways; Gateway 1 starts the 30-month preparation process.

official_measurement_examples.name: Legacy submission deadline
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning Inspectorate guidance says the last date for legacy-system local plan submissions is 31 December 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Gateway 1 minimum timing
official_measurement_examples.fact: Gateway 1 must occur at least four months after notice or the day after scoping consultation ends, whichever is later.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning Data standard commencement
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Planning Data (England) Regulations 2026 data standard commenced on 7 May 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Plan timetable publication
official_measurement_examples.fact: Authorities must publish plan and plan-timetable datasets and keep timetable information current.

official_measurement_examples.name: Housing requirement publication
official_measurement_examples.fact: The housing requirement must be published at proposed-plan consultation and republished at later specified milestones.

official_measurement_examples.name: Gateway 3 readiness
official_measurement_examples.fact: Gateway 3 assesses readiness to submit the plan for examination after Gateway 2 and proposed-plan consultation steps.

core_rules: Gateway 1 passage is not local plan adoption
Gateway 2 assessment is not local plan adoption
Gateway 3 passage is not local plan adoption
30-month timetable is an expected process framework not guaranteed adoption time
legacy-system submission deadline is not expiry of already adopted plans
new-system commencement does not invalidate legacy plans
plan timetable is not development permission
plan-data publication is not plan adoption
housing requirement is not parcel housing capacity
local-plan housing requirement is not planning permission
site identification is not site allocation
site assessment is not site allocation
draft allocation is not adopted allocation
adopted allocation is not planning permission
call for sites submission is not allocation
landowner promotion is not evidence of availability without verification
availability is distinct from suitability
suitability is distinct from achievability
achievability is not planning permission
site score is a plan-making tool not Future Growth score
Gateway advice is not a planning application decision
Planning Inspectorate gateway observations are not examination conclusions
examination submission is not adoption
examination hearing is not plan adoption
Inspector recommendations are not adoption until authority completes required steps
main modifications consultation is not adoption
examination pause is not plan withdrawal
plan withdrawal is not parcel planning refusal
notice of intention to commence is not Gateway 1 passage
scoping consultation is not proposed-plan consultation
community engagement response is not policy adoption
plan timetable date is not proof milestone occurred
actual-date and forecast event-date must remain distinct
Planning Data dataset coverage is not legal completeness of development plan
CSV compliance is not policy soundness
data validation is not plan examination
published housing requirement must retain its plan stage
15-year minimum plan period is not a parcel delivery horizon
spatial strategy is not a parcel permission
SEA assessment is not planning permission
reasonable alternative is not preferred site
preferred site is not adopted allocation
joint-plan working is not joint committee adoption
supplementary plan is distinct from local plan
current 2026 regulations must not be mixed with superseded 2012 procedure
source dates and dual-running status must be preserved
no parcel allocation permission or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
research confidence is not parcel plan-making accuracy
